page.layout: One printed page: an engraved architectural title page. Central cartouche with the title in roman type, lines of text in the upper frame, and a lower cartouche with the imprint. A green library stamp lies over the centre and is left out.
page.notes: The title page is an engraving in a faded, low-contrast scan, and much of the text is printed as show-through from the reverse, which is mirrored and not transcribed. The readable words are only "ANNALES" and "Antiquæ et Modernæ". The remaining title lines and the lower imprint (a name, a place, and a date in roman numerals) cannot be read with confidence, so they are marked illegible. The line count is approximate. The lower cartouche reads roughly "Impensis Jacobi Frid..." with a date in the form MDCLXXXVIII, which is uncertain and not transcribed. The green library stamp is omitted.
